D4=[(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]
def denoise(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    Cs=[];seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if seen[i][j]: continue
            c=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)];seen[i][j]=True;cells=[]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop();cells.append((a,b))

                        seen[x][y]=True;st.append((x,y))

        nonbg=[k for k in tops if k!=bg]

    return out
